15. LAN vs WAN
A LAN connects devices in a local area; a WAN connects geographically separated networks.
LAN එක Jගදෙර Jහහෝ office එJක් local devices connect කරනවා. WAN එක දුරින් තිJයන networks
Office laptops reach a remote cloud server through a router.
